description: scheduler.ts drops interim captions at median RTF > 0.8 and pauses live STT at > 1.5, where RTF = decode time / utterance length (live-provider.ts). Autoregressive decode has fixed overhead, so short utterances ('yeah') report RTF near or above 1 and push the level up, making captions final-only or paused. Use compute per second of NEW audio over a rolling window, ignore utterances under ~1 s, and degrade on real backlog (sttBacklogS) rather than per-call RTF. Tests for short-utterance streams not escalating.
title: Fix ComputeScheduler load signal
